name: Grand Teton National Park
policyReason: A pet may go anywhere a car may go; no trails, pathways, beaches or buildings.
summary: A pet may go anywhere a car may go; no trails, pathways, beaches or buildings.

excerpts.quote: Pets are prohibited in the backcountry and on park trails.

dogRules.text: Not on trails, the multi-use pathway, beaches or in buildings.
Allowed in campgrounds, turnouts, picnic areas and on roads.
Bridger-Teton National Forest trails allow pets.
